title: Hardware Test Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 




 Xcubated Business Solutions (XBS) is a technology and consulting firm composed of experienced professionals with multi\-industry and global exposure. The company partners with clients to deliver future\-ready solutions across advisory services, digital transformation, global delivery center operations, and next\-generation innovations. XBS focuses on areas such as IT strategy, smart city advisory, digital platforms, mobile applications, and automation using tools like ServiceNow and Cherwell. The organization also invests in advanced technologies including deep learning, big data, wearables, AR/VR, and AI/ML.
 



  





**Hiring: Test Engineer / Trainee \| Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) Testing** 




  





 We are seeking a motivated Test Engineer / Trainee to join a dynamic engineering team working on cutting\-edge robotics, motion control, and embedded systems. This is an excellent opportunity for recent graduates or early\-career professionals looking to build expertise in Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) testing, automation, and robotics validation.
 



  





 📍 Location: Kochi (Work from Office)
 



  🕒 Working Hours: Germany Business Hours
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Perform daily regression testing of firmware and software tools.
* Operate and maintain robotic joint test benches and testing infrastructure.
* Develop and enhance robust Python/pytest\-based automation frameworks.
* Ensure comprehensive test coverage for motion drive firmware and software.
* Maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated test execution, and reporting mechanisms.
* Support the validation of robotic systems by bridging software simulation and physical hardware testing environments.



  





**Desired Profile** 



* B.Tech/M.Tech in Mechatronics, Electrical, Electronics, or related disciplines.
* Strong interest in Robotics, Embedded Systems, Automation Testing, and Motion Control.
* Exposure to Python programming and software testing methodologies.
* Familiarity with pytest, GitHub, Jenkins, CI/CD tools, firmware testing, or HIL environments is advantageous.
* Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
* Enthusiasm to learn and work with advanced robotic and embedded technologies.



  





**Why Join Us?** 




  





 ✅ Hands\-on experience with real\-world robotic systems and test environments
 



 ✅ Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge motion control technologies
 



 ✅ Exposure to automation frameworks, CI/CD practices, and firmware validation
 



 ✅ Collaborative and innovation\-driven engineering culture

title: Data Quality Engineering Lead
description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for an experienced Data Quality Engineering Lead to ensure the master data content quality and develop systems that continue to improve the quality of the data content. This role requires the ability to define and govern quality strategy to better serve our customers. The ideal candidate bridges the gap between engineering and quality, embedding testing excellence throughout the software development lifecycle.
   

  

 This is a full\-time position and reports directly to the VP, Engineering.
   

  

***Preferred Location***
 Qualified candidates should be based in or near Kochi and able to work from our Kochi office as part of a hybrid schedule.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
**Test Automation Architecture**
* Design, implement and maintain scalable, maintainable data quality automation
* Implement test reporting and analytics solutions, or custom dashboards to surface quality insights


**Cloud, DevOps \& CI/CD Integration**
* Utilize AWS services relevant to quality engineering, including CodePipeline, CodeBuild, ECS, Lambda, S3, and CloudWatch Synthetics
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, BitBucket pipelines, or AWS CodePipeline


**Leadership \& Quality Strategy**
* Define and govern a quality strategy across multiple product teams, including test standards, tooling selection, and metrics frameworks
* Lead and mentor QA engineers and SDETs across automated, manual, and exploratory testing disciplines
* Track and present quality KPIs — including defect escape rate, test coverage, MTTR, and automation ROI — to senior stakeholder


***Education Requirement***
 Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent education and work experience.
   

  

**Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* 7\+ years of experience in software and quality engineering, with at least 3 years leading data quality engineering
* Proven track record automating and measuring data quality assurance in production environments
* Proficient in SQL
* Proficient in Python or R
* Proficient with Git for source control
* Experience developing QA automation on AWS or equivalent cloud platforms
* Preferred Experience, Knowledge and Skills
* Experience using AI development tools
* Proficient in Apache Spark (pyspark)


**Preferred Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* Experience using AI development tools.
* Proficient in Apache Spark (pyspark)
* Experience with data quality frameworks Great Expectations or Deequ
* Familiarity with Jenkins


**About Dodge Construction Network**
 Dodge Construction Network exists to deliver the comprehensive data and connections the construction industry needs to build thriving communities. Our legacy is deeply rooted in empowering our customers with transformative insights, igniting their journey towards unparalleled business expansion and success. We serve decision\-makers who seek reliable growth and who value relationships built on trust and quality. By combining our proprietary data with cutting\-edge software, we deliver to our customers the essential intelligence needed to excel within their respective landscapes. We propel the construction industry forward by transforming data into tangible guidance, driving unparalleled advancement.
   

  

 Dodge is the catalyst for modern construction.

Business Efficiency and Evolution will work closely with the business and the Global Process Owners to set the strategic direction and road map for Mercury, enabling process efficiency and standardization through:
   

  

* centralized business process governance
* portfolio planning, demand management and prioritization
* analysis of business requirements and the identification of process improvement opportunities, aligned with business KPIs, which can be delivered via the Mercury solution
* robust governance, stewardship and audit of Mercury data

 As a part of the Business Efficiency and Evolution function, the Data Steward Technical plays a key role in driving the benefit and value from the Mercury solution. Working with key stakeholders in MST IT and Business functions, the Mercury Program, and firm wide Data Governance Stakeholders, the Data Steward is responsible for the implementation of the firm’s data management metrics and improvement strategies.  Data Stewards’ primary function is to design, implement and enhance systems, tools and solutions to enable the MST data governance function.  Success in the role will be evaluated based on the specific goals for implementation of data quality metrics and the direct, tangible cost reductions and business benefits derived from their continuous improvement activities.

* Design, implement and enhance automated data quality assessments, compliance metrics and KPIs.
* Design, implement and enhance automated data profiling and integration of internal and external data sources required for effective governance.

* Facilitate and enable ongoing definition and implementation of data standards to mitigate risks associated with key data elements.
* Produce key measurements that communicate governance performance, including KPIs, monthly achievements, project status and issues to be addressed
* Translate team priorities into actionable plans to meet strategic objectives of the Data Governance function.
* Develop multiple relationships across the organization and own team, based on authenticity and respect. Other parts of the business include IT, Finance, Data Privacy (GCO), Risk, Business Reporting Group, Service Lines Leaders, Area leadership, Talent Leadership
* Go beyond technical excellence aspects to provide insights including thought leadership, embedding leading practice methods and processes to deliver value from Data Governance function.

* Serve as contributor and subject area expert in the collaborative review of new data designs and development.
* Escalate data management decisions that cannot be made easily or due to unresolved conflict
* Provide a business case and resource estimates for development work required for Governance processes and data quality profiling, monitoring and reporting
* Provide expert knowledge through research and acquired business knowledge

Provide an example.)

title: QA Executive & Aquaculture Field Technician
description:
This job is provided by apna.co Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Raw Material Inspection


  Assess species, size, grade, freshness, and physical condition.
   

  

  Verify receiving temperature and condition of chilled/frozen materials.
   

  

  Ensure supplier/lot identification and traceability. Reject or hold materials that fail to meet specifications.
   

  

* Processing Monitoring


  Oversee washing, grading, deheading/peeling, freezing, and glazing. Verify product temperature at
   

  

 critical stages.
   

  

  Ensure compliance with SOPs and product specifications.
   

  

* HACCP \& Food Safety


  Monitor CCPs/OPRPs and critical limits.
   

  

  Record monitoring results and act immediately on deviations.
   

  

  Verify corrective actions and follow\-up measures.
   

  

* Personal Hygiene \& GMP


  Monitor worker hygiene and protective clothing.
   

  

  Ensure proper handwashing/sanitization practices.
   

  

  Enforce GMP and GHP standards in processing areas.
   

  

* Hazard Control


  Monitor cleaning and sanitation chemicals.
   

  

  Prevent chemical and foreign\-body contamination.
   

  

  Inspect equipment, utensils, and processing areas for hygiene.
   

  

* Finished Product Inspection


  Check appearance, colour, odour, texture, size/grade, weight, glazing, packaging, and labelling.
   

  

  Verify product against customer and internal specifications.
   

  

* Packaging \& Labelling


  Confirm correct packaging materials are used.
   

  

  Verify product details: name, species, grade, net weight, production/expiry dates, lot/batch number,
   

  

 storage instructions. Ensure compliance with customer\-specific requirements.
   

  

* Cold Chain Monitoring


  Monitor freezing, cold\-room, and dispatch temperatures.
   

  

  Ensure frozen products are maintained at ≤ −18°C.
   

  

  Record and report deviations.
   

  

* Traceability


  Maintain traceability from raw material to dispatch.
   

  

  Verify GRN, production, packing, and dispatch records.
   

  

* Non\-Conformance \& Corrective Action


  Identify and segregate non\-conforming products/processes.
   

  

  Raise NCRs and investigate root causes. Verify corrective/preventive actions.
   

  

* Documentation


  Maintain QC inspection records, CCP monitoring logs, temperature checks, sanitation reports, product
   

  

 inspection reports, calibration records, etc. Ensure records are complete, accurate, and audit\-ready.
   

  

* Field Aquaculture Supervision


  To travel to farm location in and around Alappuzha and collect and report aquaculture farm data
   

  

 weekly/monthly as per company requirements and report it to the respective teams.
   

  

  Provide technical support and ensure compliance with Best Aquaculture practise standards for Basa
   

  

 farming/ Shrimp farming/ other species. Supervise harvesting and dispatch operations.
   

  

  Maintain detailed records of farming activities and produce reports for each visit.
   

  

 Skills \& Attributes
   

  

  Basic computer and MS office skills.
   

  

  Analytical thinking and attention to detail.
   

  

  Strong communication skills, especially in explaining technical concepts to farmers.
   

  

  Adaptability to diverse field conditions and travel requirements.
   

  

  Ability to work independently and in teams.
   

  

  Relationship\-building and trust with aquaculture farmers and train them in aquaculture techniques
   

  

 during field visits.
